ja300:1.2: feeding on their flesh and blood,
ja300:2.1: Sakka, understanding his vow, approached in the form of a goat,
ja300:2.3: Impenitent, fallen, the blood-drinker broke his austerity.
ja300:3.1: So some feeble people here in the world, in their undertaking,
ja300:3.3: Quickly make themselves (give up) like the wolf did because of the goat.
